lines.zh: 我走在队列侧面，随时纠正。
lines.en: I walk beside the rank, correcting as I go.
My crest arrives before I do.
Close up behind; do not leave gaps.

lines.zh: 步伐压住，一百人的脚要一声。
lines.en: Lock the step; a hundred feet must sound as one.
I count heads as I walk.
Shields level; do not make me repeat it.
My boots cross mud without breaking rhythm.
I have marched this road three times.
A centurion's pace is the measure.

lines.zh: 谁掉队，谁今晚多站一班。
lines.en: Whoever falls behind takes an extra watch tonight.
I hear the laggard without turning around.

lines.zh: 队伍往哪走，我先往哪走。
lines.en: Where the column goes, my feet go first.

lines.zh: 我站着，眼睛在队列上扫。
lines.en: I stand, eyes sweeping the rank.
My vine staff taps the ground beside me.
No talking; stand straight.
I am waiting on orders from above.
My crest has slipped; I set it straight.

lines.zh: 这十五点护甲，压得肩熟。
lines.en: Fifteen points of armor; my shoulders know it.

lines.zh: 一个百人队，少一个都不行。
lines.en: A century is short if it lacks one man.
I shift the gladius square at my hip.

lines.zh: 远处的旗还在，我就安心。
lines.en: The standard still stands, so I rest easy.

lines.zh: 我数到第一百个，才点头。
lines.en: Only after counting to a hundred do I nod.

lines.zh: 你站姿太松，像没受过训。
lines.en: Your stance is loose, untrained.
Name and purpose.
I size up your boots.

lines.zh: 你手放在剑上，我看见了。
lines.en: Your hand is on your weapon; I saw it.

lines.zh: 我不用抬头也知道你怕。
lines.en: I need not look up to know you are afraid.

lines.zh: 你比我矮半头，气势倒不弱。
lines.en: Half a head shorter, yet not timid.
You carry no standard.
I am wondering if you are a deserter.
That look says you mean to fight.
Back to camp; stop drifting here.
I grit my teeth and swallow the pain.

lines.zh: 百夫长不会在队列前倒。
lines.en: A centurion does not fall before the rank.

lines.zh: 这一下砸得我眼前发黑。
lines.en: That blow darkens my sight.

lines.zh: 我按住甲片，血从指缝出。
lines.en: I press the plate; blood seeps between my fingers.
It hurts, but the formation holds.

lines.zh: 十五点护甲，也挡不住这一下。
lines.en: Fifteen points of armour did not stop that.
I will bind this at camp.

lines.zh: 头盔上的横冠被打歪了。
lines.en: My transverse crest is knocked askew.
I switch the staff to my right hand.
One breath, and I am still standing.

lines.zh: 先给队里，剩下的才是你的。
lines.en: The century eats first; then you.
How many does that bread feed?
I smell olives.

lines.zh: 一顿好饭能留住一条命。
lines.en: A good meal keeps a man alive.
We eat first, then I speak.
Steady your hands; I divide it evenly.
Is there water left in the canteen?

lines.zh: 这点吃的，塞牙缝都不够。
lines.en: That would not fill a tooth gap.
I swallow and keep my hands still.
Let the youngest take first.
Do not shove; the line will break.
You just bumped a centurion.
One step back into your place.
Plate on plate makes too much noise.

lines.zh: 我用藤杖敲了下你的腿。
lines.en: My vine staff taps your leg.
Stand firm and stop treading on the man ahead.
Your shield rim scrapes me; it will leave a mark.
Clear the middle lane.
I turn sideways and give half a body's width.
Bump me if you must, not the standard.
Not in this camp.
My wife's letter is still in my tunic.
First I serve out these three years.
What are you laughing at? That is regulation.

lines.zh: 我把这事记在退役以后。
lines.en: I file that matter under "after discharge".
The men are watching; keep it together.

lines.zh: 我连自己的帐篷都少回。
lines.en: I barely visit my own tent.
Do not spend your mind on that.
Family matters wait until the war ends.
I am not good at such words.
Fallen gear belongs to the unit; I take it.
I can use this; hand it over.
I stuff it into the marching pack.

lines.zh: 谁丢的，来领的时候说清楚。
lines.en: Whoever lost this must explain at reclaim.
Better picked up than trodden on.
This is supply, not private property.
I lean on the staff as I stoop.
Every item goes in the ledger.
Anything else? I will take it all.
I knot the cord tight so it will not drop.
You crossed the line.
Century, eyes front; someone is here.
I tuck the staff behind my belt.
The target is you; stop glancing about.
I have checked your exits; there are none.
You are one; we are a hundred.
Now this looks like proper soldiering.
I raise the blade and the rank follows.
You picked a bad spot.

lines.zh: 我盯住你握武器的那只手。
lines.en: I fix on the hand holding your weapon.

lines.zh: 号手不用吹了，我在这儿。
lines.en: No need for the horn; I am here.
I move before you do.
Open the formation and box him in.
I take half a step; the whole rank does.
I have waited all day for this.

lines.zh: 百人队的号令在我喉间。
lines.en: The century's command is in my throat.
My gladius is lighter than this armor.
I have counted every way you can retreat.
The shield wall closes in.
That hand of yours will not stop shaking.
I wait for your first swing.
You tire first; then I move.
Close fighting is won with the feet.
I squeeze the space you can use.
The wall behind you works for me.
This fight should not drag on.
My gladius low, hunting armor gaps.
When the knees give, the man falls.
I shift the staff to my left.
Changing position will not help you.
The men are silent; they are waiting.
My breathing stays even.
Half a step closer and it is too late.
This armor is not decoration.
I am teaching you what pressure means.
You have one path left.
The gladius goes into your side.
The vine staff snaps at your knee.
I step in and the blade travels with me.
The shield rim cracks your jaw.
This blow is a lesson for the recruits.
One strike from me, and it lands hard.
My gladius thrusts past my shield rim.
You guard left; I hit right.
I crash into your chest.
The point slides in at the armor's seam.

lines.zh: 这一下我叫你记住百夫长。
lines.en: This one will teach you a centurion's name.
I recover the blade and let you fall on your own.
You retreat; I take half a step after.
My shield pins your weapon.
I hammer your hand with the pommel.
Your weight is off; I saw it.

lines.zh: 这一记打在你举盾的手臂。
lines.en: This one lands on your shield arm.
I do not shout; the strike is enough.
Raise it again and you are half a beat late.
The blade returns to my hip, ready again.
The standard is here; so am I, beneath it.
This century lacks a man to lead it.
I cinch the crest strap tight.
New ground; I study the terrain first.
I take the front of the column.
This open ground will do for a formation.
My blade has not yet tasted blood.

lines.zh: 从营地带出来的人都在。
lines.en: Everyone I brought from camp is here.
With me here, the rank will not break.

lines.zh: 我把藤杖在掌心敲了敲。
lines.en: I tap the vine staff against my palm.
Who commands here? I need him.

lines.zh: 十五点护甲，走起来有声。
lines.en: Fifteen points of armor, and it announces me.

lines.zh: 火焰烧进甲缝，我拍了两下。
lines.en: Fire sears into my armor; I slap it twice.
I shield my crest as I hit the ground.
The armor drags me down; I fight upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸把队列掀开一个口子。
lines.en: The blast tears a hole in the formation.

lines.zh: 箭穿过甲片，扎进我的肩。
lines.en: The arrow splits the plate and bites my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的手指发僵。
lines.en: That light leaves my fingers stiff.
Rations ran out; my legs feel hollow.
The bolt climbs up my vine staff.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我抓着盾往下掉。
lines.en: No ground beneath me; I fall clutching the shield.
